note: Offline fallback for the Firmware tab: the 30 most popular free, open-source FM-1 firmwares (cards #1-10, list #11-30) by ln(1+stars) + ln(1+.fwsc downloads). Refreshed nightly by .github/workflows/watch-releases.yml after a complete scan; by hand: python tools/fm1_discover.py --write.

projects.name: SLOOP
projects.desc: Live four-track groovebox by 3dSam: three synths plus a drum machine, 37 drum kits, punch-in FX, layer system, song mode, web editor

projects.name: Melodee
projects.desc: Felucca derivative that went its own way: ten engines, eight patterns per track, STUDIO workspaces, four-channel USB audio input, TR-808 kit

projects.name: Felucca
projects.desc: Multi-engine synth firmware by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments)

projects.name: Skiff
projects.desc: Six-track groovebox with fourteen synth and drum engines, 143 factory sounds, a 64-step sequencer with chords, ratchets, trig conditions and parameter locks…

projects.name: ChoralRoot
projects.desc: Orchid-style chord instrument: one hand plays roots, the other shapes chords, with voicings, key modes, bass and a looper

projects.name: X0X
projects.desc: ReBirth-style groovebox by Charles Vestal: TR-909, TR-808, two TB-303s with TB-3PO acid generators and a breakbeat slicer, each with its own sequencer

projects.name: OberVave
projects.desc: Single eight-voice analog-style polysynth after the classic American poly synths of 1979-84, with hard sync, cross-modulation, SEM-style filter morph…

projects.name: AMB-1
projects.desc: Generative ambient machine inspired by Music for Airports that plays itself from power-on: tape loops of unequal length, gliding bass, Euclidean percussion

projects.name: Hortator
projects.desc: Eight-track drum machine by DEADACTIVE with 808, 909 and Plaits drum models, samples, Mutable Instruments Grids, a pumping compressor and resonators

projects.name: GHOULBOX
projects.desc: Dungeon synth firmware by Jason Persinger: cathedral reverb, worn-tape effect, hurdy-gurdy engine with drones, dark ambient presets and an old-RPG screen

projects.name: FoMni
projects.desc: Omnichord-style chord harp by Charles Vestal: strum the white keys, pick chords on the black ones, with rhythm patterns and auto bass

projects.name: LOOM-8
projects.desc: OP-XY-inspired groovebox by Charles Vestal: eight colour-coded tracks, 85 factory presets, a 64-step sequencer with step tricks and parameter locks, weave…

projects.name: Clipper
projects.desc: Experimental synthesizer firmware that grew out of SLOOP, with per-voice ENV2/ENV3 and LFO2/LFO3 modulation

projects.name: Jangada
projects.desc: Felucca fork adding superwave analog, a modulation matrix, latched drones, ratchets and synthesized drum kits

projects.name: ORBIT
projects.desc: SLOOP-based groovebox with OP-1-inspired screens, sample tools and an event tape for moving what the four tracks play

projects.name: Optimist
projects.desc: Modular firmware platform derived from SLOOP: a firmware builder lets you pick which engines, kits and effects fit in flash

projects.name: DUB-1
projects.desc: Generative dub techno machine that plays itself from power-on: chord stabs into a tape echo, FM pings, sub bass, kick, shaker and hat on an eight-bar…

projects.name: Polly
projects.desc: QY70-style pocket arranger by Charles Vestal: a style plays a band of eight instruments steered by the chords you play, with General MIDI sounds from Sonivox…

projects.name: Tessera
projects.desc: Generative firmware, formerly Melodee (Tess): 13 generators, song forms and modulation on four tracks

projects.name: CoralFlower
projects.desc: Chord instrument inspired by the Telepathic Instruments Orchid: every note becomes a chord with a bass underneath, while a pixel flower grows on screen

projects.name: CTL-1
projects.desc: Turns the FM-1 into a MIDI controller, with General MIDI sounds of its own

projects.name: GR!MM
projects.desc: Dark ambient, dungeon synth and deathdream firmware: four tracks, seven sound sources, long dark effects, a 64-step sequencer and one-key chords

projects.name: FMini-1
projects.desc: Minimoog Model D emulation by Guilherme Ruppert with effects, arpeggiator and sequencer

projects.name: FiMba-1
projects.desc: Physically modelled kalimba with mbira patterns, granular cloud and tape

projects.name: FuMi-1
projects.desc: Shigin accompaniment instrument inspired by Suikohsha's ST-50, with koto, sho, shakuhachi and taiko voices and the ST-50's just tuning

projects.name: MAKU
projects.desc: Always-on ambience machine: it starts a new random in-key world on every boot and draws later ones from the pieces you like

projects.name: Frodhes
projects.desc: Physically modelled electric piano, vibraphone and marimba with no samples, plus effects, arpeggiator, sequencer, scales and a web emulator

projects.name: DUELL
projects.desc: Bitimbral synthesizer by OSCILL/R: two complete parts, three ways to play them together and a morph between two versions of every sound

projects.name: Shine On
projects.desc: Seventies string machine on four tracks with six formant registers, BBD ensemble and phaser, mixer, step sequencer and 32 programs

projects.name: Ravel
projects.desc: Eight-track groovebox for sound design where synth, struck and drum tracks trigger, excite and modulate one another, with thirteen synth engines, a graph…
